A night not to remember.
Feb 2019 • Couples
We were about to get some supper after a fairly long trip from Laos and wandered down the hotel to the back bar. I noticed the restaurant over the road which was full of clients on the footpath having a great time so I talked the wife into going there instead. We sat inside and watched the wine flow outside, the order which wasn't large was placed and we ordered a wine and waited and waited and waited. I stopped our waiter who was racing outside with carafes of expensive wines several times but he would smile and indicate "just a moment". After an hour we gave up and plodded back to the hotel. I am sure it was a lovely restaurant but we will never know.

Very average
Feb 2018 • Couples
Went here for dinner. Pretty quiet. Ordered drinks: martini and old fashioned. Couldn’t do martini so changed to Cosmo which arrived but wasn’t a Cosmo.

Food ordered which came within 20 minutes although my drink still hadn’t arrived. Crisp pork and shrimp turned out to be tough, chewy pork with 2 prawns. My wife’s duck was dry.

Door to restaurant open and someone outside smoking a large cigar which stank.

Great Setting, Great Food
Dec 2017 • Family
Really enjoyed the food here. Had the softshell crab in tamarind sauce, pomelo salad with shrimp and banana flower salad with chicken. All super tasty. Only wish the rest of the family was feeling better so we could have ordered more. We were there on New Years Eve and it was about half full, which was a little weird b/c the food and service was great. Though it did feel kind of empty. The restaurant is an old villa, with dining spread across several rooms. We had a room all to ourselves, with three or four other empty tables. Except for feeling a little "lonely" in our own room, we had a great time.
